title: Credit Controller
description:
Your new company
A leading and well-established organisation within the utilities and customer services sector is seeking to appoint a Credit Controller to join its busy operations team in Belfast. Renowned for its strong workplace culture, employee development opportunities, and commitment to customer service excellence, this organisation offers a supportive environment where employees are encouraged to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact.With a strong focus on teamwork, employee wellbeing, and flexible working arrangements, this is an excellent opportunity to join a highly regarded employer that values its people and invests in their success.
Your new role
Reporting to the Credit Manager, you will play a key role in reducing customer arrears, improving cash flow performance, and ensuring all relevant regulatory requirements, data protection standards, and internal procedures are followed.As Credit Controller, your responsibilities will include:
- Managing a portfolio of customer accounts and proactively reducing outstanding debt.
- Conducting inbound and outbound telephone calls to customers regarding overdue balances.
- Negotiating affordable repayment arrangements and resolving customer payment issues.
- Investigating customer accounts and tracing debtors where required.
- Liaising with third-party agencies and internal stakeholders to progress debt recovery activities.
- Maintaining accurate account records and updating internal systems.
- Working towards individual and team performance targets and KPIs.
- Escalating cases and providing reports in line with regulatory and compliance requirements.
- Delivering a high standard of customer service while balancing commercial objectives.

This role would suit an experienced collections, credit control, or customer account specialist who thrives in a fast-paced and target-driven environment.
What you'll need to succeed
- A minimum of 2 years' experience within Credit Control, Collections, Customer Accounts, or a similar customer-focused environment.
- Experience managing a high volume of customer interactions and negotiating successful payment outcomes.
- Previous experience working within a target-driven and fast-paced environment.
- Excellent telephone and communication skills with experience handling both inbound and outbound calls.
- Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.
- A well-organised approach with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience working towards KPIs and performance objectives.
- Proficiency across Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
- The ability to remain resilient, professional, and solutions-focused when dealing with challenging situations.

What you'll get in return
- Competitive salary package.
- Annual performance-related bonus opportunity.
- Hybrid working model.
- Generous annual leave entitlement with the option to purchase additional days.
- Healthcare and wellbeing support programmes.
- Employee wellbeing fund.
- Life assurance scheme.
- Health cash plan.
- Employee assistance programme with free counselling support.
- Free on-site parking.
- Long-service recognition initiatives.
- Professional development, mentoring, and career progression opportunities.
- Access to a range of social, sports, and employee engagement activities.
- The opportunity to join a respected organisation with an excellent reputation for employee satisfaction and career development.

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Accounts Receivable Officer
description:
Accounts Receivable Officer

Location: Co. Antrim
Salary: £30-35k (DOE)
Flexible Working Hours!

Energis is currently recruiting for an Accounts Receivable Officer to join our client based in Co Antrim.

This role will focus on credit Control and payroll, managing and monitoring incoming payments, ensuring accuracy of financial transactions, maintaining customer records, and resolving payment discrepancies.

You will play a critical part in maintaining the company's cash flow and supporting overall financial operations.

Key Responsibilities:
- Process customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
- Process Payroll weekly and monthly
- Monitor accounts receivable ledger to ensure all payments are received and properly recorded.
- Follow up with customers on overdue accounts and resolve billing/payment discrepancies.
- Reconcile customer accounts and prepare aging reports.
- Apply cash receipts to customer accounts in accounting systems.
- Communicate with customers to address billing questions and provide account statements when necessary.
- Assist with month-end closing by providing accurate AR reports and schedules.
- Maintain organised records of all invoices, receipts, and correspondence.
- Collaborate with the sales and customer service teams to resolve account-related issues.
- Support internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation.

Criteria:
- Proven experience in accounts receivable and/or purchase ledger
- Working knowledge of payroll
- Proficiency in accounting software, ideally Sage
- Advanced Excel skills with strong attention to detail
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

Benefits:
- Competitive salary (£30-35k)
- Flexible hours
- Bonus scheme
- Life insurance
- Private healthcare
- Pension scheme

This is an excellent opportunity to join a progressive company offering strong benefits and long-term career development.

For further information and a confidential discussion please email your CV through the link.

title: Finance Officer
company: Your World Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Band 5 Finance Officer
Location: Newtownards / Hybrid working - 3 days in office, 2 at home
Job Type: Temporary
Duration of booking: Expected to last 3 months with possible extension
Proposed start date: ASAP
Pay Rates: Up to £15.88 per hour PAYE inclusive of holiday pay
Hours / Working Days: 37.5 hours per week / Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm
Job Description
- To liaise with, and meet with senior Trust staff in order to assist with their understanding of budgets or to assist with any related queries.
- Assist with the annual budget setting process within agreed guidelines and timetables, and helping to ensure that they reflect the Trust's financial strategy and income profile.
- Assist the Band 7 Finance Officer in contributing to the development of cash releasing efficiency plans, recovery plans and contingency plans for the directorate.
- Support the Finance Manager in the early identification of threats to the financial stability of the Trust by highlighting risks within the directorate and agreeing rectification measures to ensure breakeven is achieved.
- To assist in developing the use of financial systems, reporting and enquiry tools and working methods to advance the quality and efficiency of Financial Management information.
- To deal with ad hoc reporting and enquiries as required by Senior Finance Managers and other senior Trust staff.

Criteria for Application:
- Hold a current drivers licence and is a car driver
- University degree and 2 years suitable relevant financial experience
- or, AAT/HND qualified and 2 years suitable relevant financial experience

or, Part Qualified with one of the CCAB recognised bodies and 1 years suitable relevant financial experience
or, 3 years suitable relevant financial experience at Band 4 level
- Excellent written and verbal communication with a range of stakeholders
- Competent at Microsoft Excel, ability to manipulate large volumes of data, wide range of functions and then provide analysis on this data
- Confident with accounting principles - accruals, prepayments etc.
- Ideally, experience in management accounts, investigating variances.
- Ability to manage workload to meet department deadlines
